description.text: One of the two expansions released on 26 January 2024, together with Wild Force, in which the Ancient and Future Pokémon fully awaken. Its Future Pokémon ex are future forms of the legendary Pokémon of Unova, Iron Leaves ex, Iron Crown ex and Iron Boulder ex, with Iron Thorns, Iron Valiant and the Supporter Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking. As in Wild Force, ACE SPEC cards, so strong that a deck may hold only one, returned for the first time in eleven years with their own rarity, ACE: here Prime Catcher, Reboot Pod and Hero's Cape. Incineroar ex, Scizor ex and the Tera Pokémon Farigiraf ex join them, with the Supporters Salvatore and Bianca's Devotion. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Iron Leaves ex, Iron Crown ex and Iron Boulder ex. In English most of its cards came out in Temporal Forces in March 2024.
